title: How Do Your Biomedical Named Entity Recognition Models Generalize to Novel Entities?

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of error cases to demonstrate that models over-rely on the statistical class distributions of individual words seen in the training set, followed by the application of a statistics-based bias product method to mitigate these spurious correlations.

Evaluating model performance on novel biomedical entities with rare morphological patterns (e.g., COVID-19 and rare diseases from the NORD database) and testing the effect of replacing or augmenting training data with pseudo-entity patterns to improve generalization.
